summary: Huachen AI Parking Management Technology Holding Co., Ltd, a Cayman-incorporated, Shanghai-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting a September 15, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement with certain investors for a best-efforts offering of 2,750,000 Class A ordinary shares plus warrants for up to 2,750,000 more shares at $1.00 per unit, grossing US$2.75 million. Warrants are immediately exercisable at $1.00 for three years with full-ratchet and anti-dilution reset mechanics. This is an ordinary marketed equity/warrant financing with a placement agent, not a special situation; watch dilution and warrant overhang.
